name: Americold Data Incident Settlement
summary: For people in the United States who were notified by Americold that their private information was impacted in its 2020 and/or 2023 data incidents.

eligibility_rules.question: Did Americold notify you that your private information was impacted in its 2020 and/or 2023 data incident?

benefit_summary: Estimated residual cash payment of $100 for one affected incident or $200 for both incidents; documented out-of-pocket losses may be reimbursed up to $25,000, subject to the settlement terms.

name: On Q Financial Data Security Settlement
summary: For individuals whose private information may have been compromised in the On Q Financial data security incident on or around February 20, 2024.

eligibility_rules.question: Were you told, or do you otherwise know, that your private information may have been compromised in the On Q Financial data security incident around February 20, 2024?

benefit_summary: Alternative cash payment estimated at $50, or reimbursement of documented ordinary and extraordinary losses up to $5,000, subject to the settlement terms.

name: Roseland Community Hospital Data Incident Settlement
summary: For individuals whose private information was potentially compromised in Roseland Community Hospital's June 2024 data incident and who were sent an individual notification.

eligibility_rules.question: Did Roseland Community Hospital send you an individual notification that your private information may have been affected by its June 2024 data incident?

benefit_summary: Pro-rata cash payment estimated at $50, or reimbursement of documented ordinary and extraordinary losses up to $5,000, subject to the settlement terms.
